newsitem.title: USA: Action Industries trading halted on AMEX.
newsitem.headline: Action Industries trading halted on AMEX.

text.p: Action Industries Inc said Monday that the American Stock Exchange has halted trading in its stock because it failed to meet the filing deadline for its 10K for the year ended June 30.
The company said it plans to file the 10K form "within the next two to four days."
The company said it had previously announced a delay in filing its annual 10K because it needed to complete negotiations on two contracts that had a "significant imapct" on its financial statements.
The company said resumption of trading awaits the delivery of its 10K form to AMEX and depends on the Exchange's review of its qualifications for continued listing.
